scope: Isolated required service-unit group omissions on combined ECUR INITIAL and TERMINATION
boundaries: The two archived fixtures remove the required group while retaining MSCC. INITIAL has neither unit nor a reason. TERMINATION retains FINAL and both status fields.

Receive 5005 uses the existing V2 minimum-group proof. Both 32-byte examples contain a minimal MSCC header and one complete group with a zero-filled UInt64 child. Exact byte, depth, count, field, frame and whole-answer limits were tested.

Build/Send preserve the original unsupported classification. Receive preserves that sentinel and adds missing evidence for the isolated omission. Mixed reason, unit, status and earlier action controls retain their old paths. Present-but-empty groups identify the missing child. Both TCP/TLS loopback policies were verified.
